WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '20210128'
    AND user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
url_parts AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    ARRAY(SELECT part FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS part WHERE part != '') AS non_empty_parts,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(ARRAY(SELECT part FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS part WHERE part != '')) AS num_non_empty
  FROM page_views
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 5, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(3)], NULL) AS seg4,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 5, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(4)], NULL) AS seg5,
    IF(num_non_empty >= 1, non_empty_parts[OFFSET(num_non_empty - 1)], NULL) AS last_seg,
    num_non_empty >= 5 AS has_enough_segments
  FROM url_parts
),
classified2 AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    seg4,
    seg5,
    last_seg,
    has_enough_segments,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(seg4), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') 
      OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(seg5), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') AS has_category,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(last_seg, r'\+') AS last_has_plus,
    NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(seg4, r'\+') AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(seg5, r'\+') AS no_plus_in_4_5
  FROM classified
),
with_display AS (
  SELECT
    page_title,
    event_timestamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn,
    CASE 
      WHEN has_enough_segments AND has_category AND last_has_plus THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN has_enough_segments AND has_category AND NOT last_has_plus AND no_plus_in_4_5 THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_page
  FROM classified2
),
with_group AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    display_page,
    CASE WHEN display_page = LAG(display_page) OVER (ORDER BY rn) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_new_group
  FROM with_display
),
with_group_id AS (
  SELECT
    rn,
    display_page,
    SUM(is_new_group) OVER (ORDER BY rn) AS group_id
  FROM with_group
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    display_page,
    MIN(rn) AS first_rn
  FROM with_group_id
  GROUP BY display_page, group_id
  ORDER BY first_rn
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_page, '>>') AS navigation_flow
FROM merged

### Refined Page Classification Criteria

#### Overview
To enhance our understanding of user engagement on our e-commerce platform, we differentiate between two types of pages based on the URL structure: Product Listing Pages (PLPs) and Product Detail Pages (PDPs). These classifications are crucial for analyzing user behavior and improving site navigation efficiency.

#### Product Listing Pages (PLPs)
PLPs are identified by specific characteristics in the URL:
- The URL must be divided into at least five segments.
- Neither the fourth nor the fifth segment contains a '+' sign, ensuring these are not detail views.
- The fourth or fifth segment must contain one of the following category names, indicating a broader category or collection page rather than a specific product focus:
  - Accessories
  - Apparel
  - Brands
  - Campus Collection
  - Drinkware
  - Electronics
  - Google Redesign
  - Lifestyle
  - Nest
  - New 2015 Logo
  - Notebooks Journals
  - Office
  - Shop by Brand
  - Small Goods
  - Stationery
  - Wearables

#### Product Detail Pages (PDPs)
PDPs, which focus on individual products, are marked by:
- A URL split into at least five segments, akin to PLPs.
- The presence of a '+' sign in the last segment, a common marker for detailed product pages.
- The fourth or fifth segment must also include one of the specified category names, ensuring that the detail being viewed pertains to one of the recognized product categories:
  - Accessories
  - Apparel
  - Brands
  - Campus Collection
  - Drinkware
  - Electronics
  - Google Redesign
  - Lifestyle
  - Nest
  - New 2015 Logo
  - Notebooks Journals
  - Office
  - Shop by Brand
  - Small Goods
  - Stationery
  - Wearables

### Note
Please note that the page classification keywords are case-insensitive. Additionally, when identifying URLs as described above, spaces are typically replaced by the '+' sign.
